ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal) across approximately 75% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters concentrated on the lateral tips and lower-left quadrant.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling localized to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear streaks present in the lower-left quadrant. Central region exhibits uniform low-intensity distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is shallow relative to total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency is approximately 14-16 distinct peaks per lobe with amplitude increasing toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a strong convex curve transitioning into a sharp, upward-oriented distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are densely concentrated on the superior points of the lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) visible on the lower-left lobe, oriented diagonally from the lower margin toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear white scarring on the lower-left lobe consistent with rake marks; biological colonization (barnacles) visible on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific hook-shaped high-intensity white mark located near the lower margin of the left lobe, distinct from the adjacent linear abrasions.
